agency: New York State Office of Temporary and Disability Assistance (OTDA)
agency_short: New York State Office of Temporary and Disability Assistance (OTDA)
admin_note: State-SUPERVISED, county-ADMINISTERED: OTDA sets policy (18 NYCRR Part 387; SNAP Source Book; ADM/INF/LCM/GIS directives) and 58 local social services districts administer it — each county plus New York City, whose district is HRA (Human Resources Administration, part of NYC DSS). LAYER-3 RULE: state policy says what the rule is; office practice can vary by district — answer 'state policy says X; your district may differ' and point to the local district. NYC facts (ACCESS HRA portal, On Demand interviews, SNAP Centers) come from NYC HRA sources, never inferred from state text.
system: WMS (Welfare Management System) with ABEL budgeting — separate NYC and Upstate variants; some SUA names differ between the two

portal.name: myBenefits.ny.gov (statewide EXCEPT NYC; NYC uses ACCESS HRA)
portal.note: statewide EXCEPT NYC; NYC uses ACCESS HRA

update_channels.name: OTDA policy directives (ADM / INF / LCM) + GIS messages

verification.method: 5-cluster source fetch (real-browser capture for the bot-challenged host; official-URL archive copies with digest checks) → independent cross-check → draft → eval (14 cases) → adversarial refute gate.
verification.gates: Cross-check: 7/7 pivotal facts confirmed. Refute gate: 94 claims — 86 confirmed, 6 corrected, 2 flagged unverifiable and removed, 0 fabricated (incl. the Saratoga County tracking carve-out).
sources: NYC HRA / ACCESS HRA pages (county layer)
